events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and peace. What's your favourite memory or track from the legendary Woodstock Festival?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only King of Rock and Roll. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on this day.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the influence of Tupac Shakur remains as powerful as ever. Remembering a true icon of hip-hop.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Still sounds as fresh as ever. What's your top track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the one and only Liam Gallagher, who's 54 today. Still got it.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine at 51
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music, in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod arrived and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you fill yours with?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album at 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what's your hidden gem from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true showman. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. The voice, the legend.
